evals.prompt: Turn examples/prd-guest-checkout.md into Jira epics and stories we can import. Link each one back to the PRD; the wiki copy is https://wiki.northwind.example/checkout/prd-guest-checkout.
assertions: Shows the mapping from doc sections to epics and stories before or alongside the spec
Creates one epic per goal and one story per M/S/C requirement
Creates no issue for R7 (Won't have) or the non-goals, and lists them as not created
Every story has Given/When/Then acceptance criteria that restate the requirement without adding behaviour
Every item's description ends with a Source line linking to the wiki URL and the section ID
Runs the export with --doc so the spec is checked, and hands over a Jira CSV with import steps
Reports the PRD's open question as unresolved rather than turning it into a ticket with a guessed answer
Does not invent requirements, numbers or reasons not in the PRD

evals.prompt: Here's our Jira export for guest checkout (examples/tracker-after-two-weeks.csv). Does the tracker still match the PRD (examples/prd-guest-checkout.md)?
assertions: Reports R3 as a doc section with no live issue, noting CHK-205 was cancelled
Reports CHK-209 as an issue for a Won't-have requirement (R7)
Reports CHK-211 as pointing at R8, which the PRD does not have
Reports CHK-210 as an issue with no doc section
For each item gives both resolutions (change the tracker or change the doc) rather than assuming the tracker is wrong
Flags CHK-207 as linked only by mention and asks for its Source line to be restored

evals.prompt: Can you turn brief-home-delivery.md into tickets for our Jira project HDS? Our importer only accepts these columns: Summary, Issue Type, Description, Labels, Epic Name, Epic Link - it rejects the file if there's anything else, including Priority. Save it as hds-import.csv and tell me anything in the brief that needs sorting before we load it.
assertions: Writes hds-import.csv whose header uses only the six accepted columns, with no Priority or other extra column
Creates no ticket for R7 (Won't have) or for the non-goals
Reports the care-home question (Q1) as unresolved rather than turning it into a ticket with an assumed answer
Treats R3 and R8 as the same requirement, with one ticket or an explicit flag, rather than two unflagged tickets for the same work
Flags that 180 members grown by 50% is 270, which does not match the 250 in G1
Every ticket traces back to its section of the brief, by link or section ID
Does not invent requirements, numbers, owners or dates not in the brief

evals.prompt: quick one - the church hall refurb plan agreed at the AGM says this year we do: new kitchen, accessible toilet, rewiring. new chairs maybe next year, not this year. our tracker board has these cards: kitchen units, kitchen flooring, rewiring, new chairs, stage curtains. do they match? short list please, I'm the treasurer not a project person
assertions: Flags the accessible toilet as in the plan with no card
Flags stage curtains as a card with no matching plan item
Flags new chairs as a card for work the plan puts off to next year
Treats kitchen units and kitchen flooring as covering the new kitchen, and rewiring as matching, without reporting them as mismatches
Gives a short list in plain language
Does not invent costs, dates or reasons not given
Answers without asking questions first
